problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 41kg, revenue $59
* Package 2: weight 40kg, revenue $94
* Package 3: weight 23kg, revenue $140
* Package 4: weight 30kg, revenue $144
* Package 5: weight 29kg, revenue $104
* Package 6: weight 26kg, revenue $224
* Package 7: weight 24kg, revenue $59
* Package 8: weight 21kg, revenue $86
* Package 9: weight 17kg, revenue $101
* Package 10: weight 22kg, revenue $239
* Package 11: weight 50kg, revenue $51
* Package 12: weight 24kg, revenue $201
* Package 13: weight 18kg, revenue $190
* Package 14: weight 10kg, revenue $221
* Package 15: weight 14kg, revenue $112
* Package 16: weight 11kg, revenue $245
* Package 17: weight 39kg, revenue $228
* Package 18: weight 43kg, revenue $135
* Package 19: weight 49kg, revenue $10
* Package 20: weight 24kg, revenue $79
* Package 21: weight 2kg, revenue $235
* Package 22: weight 27kg, revenue $300
* Package 23: weight 7kg, revenue $36

The aircraft has a maximum payload capacity of 413 kg. Determine which package combination yields the highest total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
